name: pptx-design
description: Expert guidance for designing AND refactoring PowerPoint decks: a decided simple/clean design system (four color slots, one type scale, one grid, a density budget), typography, color, data visualization, structural diagrams, deck genres, accessibility, and slide-master setup, plus a refactor playbook for inherited or AI-generated decks — five-pass diagnosis, triage order, and the patch-in-place vs. rebuild decision, preserving the author's argument. Advice only — hands file generation and extraction to pptx-build rather than hand-writing python-pptx.
